patch.value: Report stale or contradictory knowledge in task recall
Reuse existing verification and supersession signals to expose bounded, checkable freshness and contradiction evidence during task recall.
Agents can recover source evidence for a disclosed conflict without reading every candidate.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Design: expose evidence through an opt-in SDK resume intent. Use a certified same-tracker snapshot, persist no recall exposure, keep complete rows within the existing ceiling, and report omitted rows and conflict evidence. Reuse native verification and supersession; disclose a single-field source only when it can adjudicate the competing guidance.

value.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
git fetch --tags origin && npm run changelog:full && npm run changelog:check

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Scratch copy of the public tracker, with public facts and a synthetic recorded contradiction: resume plus both status, updated_at and dependencies reads took 262 TOON tokens (100 + 69 + 93). Resume-evidence plus the named dependencies read took 233 (155 + 78), saving 29 tokens and one read. The dependencies-only baseline with native ids supplied tied at 233. Counts use the SDK UTF-8 byte estimator.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The pinned SDK stores a forward supersedes relationship. Resume-evidence derives the incoming superseded side and identifies the item that owns the edge. Explicit opposing guidance can use a persisted stale reason. Reciprocal edges and opposing guidance without a decisive source produce a conflict_sources receipt. Local targeted recall tests passed; the legacy missing-field branch has a dedicated fixture under verification.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Stock origin/main and candidate resume output matched byte-for-byte on the scratch tracker. Reading the conflict-returned source and field reproduced the named projection. Direct npm run test:install hit the 30-minute install.acceptance.ts file watchdog during the packed Bun fixture. Reference-suffix consumers and shipped-files checks passed. The unchanged install suite is running with PM_TEST_TIME_SCALE=3.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Implementation 3750d2ba92fcb8af2bedd74dd462143ad8f5945d. Typecheck, lint, identity, duplication, docstrings and regenerated changelog check passed. All four recall cases passed with 100% statements, branches, functions and lines for src/task-recall.ts. PM_TEST_TIME_SCALE=3 npm run test:install passed all four packed npm/Bun and publishing-file checks. The full quick coverage command reported a failure in the existing 1 MiB policy-framing case. That case passed on stock main and this branch in isolation, and again on this branch with V8 coverage instrumentation. The full local run is still collecting results; exact-head GitHub checks are pending.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round EB investigates CodeRabbit thread PRRT_kwDOVPw2oc65mhxy. Trace content and native write paths, reproduce stale verification through real tracker writes, and run the requested gates.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Verified the reported native body edit with a real CLI and tracker. The content edit invalidated verification in one history entry, while pm update --body retained the prior content timestamp. The SDK mutation guard receives snapshots, so invalidation must be included in the native update options before admission.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The CLI prepares native guidance invalidation before dispatch. The locked mutation guard checks that verification fields were cleared and the content clock advanced. Guarded and standalone SDK publication share the revision helper. Recall also checks persisted history for legacy and extension-free writes.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: A clean archive of 14726bf reproduced the full report: a real pm update --body persisted changed guidance, kept both verification clocks, and task recall still returned fresh. The regression now checks persisted fields, one history entry, and the recall verdict for each edit path.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: CodeRabbit thread PRRT_kwDOVPw2oc65mhxy on pm-memory#87 maps to 3ec0e45a45ac5a8a2c087226060872fd056b6728. The implementation advances the content clock and clears verification in the update itself. Real content, CLI body and title, and standalone and injected host edits all produce unverified recall. Typecheck, lint, duplication, docstrings, and changelog check passed. Full quick coverage is running.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Follow-up pm-memory-native-input-revision tracks two confirmed native input limits. Bulk body edits and document edits that echo prior verification fields currently refuse without persisting changed guidance.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The full suite exposed a recovery test whose in-process peer shared the newly active admission guard. The fixture now uses the existing independent SDK writer process for both peer writes and retains the post-no-op dependency assertions. The focused recovery case passed.

value.text: Round EI verified both CodeRabbit threads are open on 6158dac. Reproduce each through a real tracker, compare tags using native update semantics, and ensure later guidance edits take precedence over create-entry verification.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Both real-tracker regressions failed on the review head. Equivalent replacement tags cleared the verification fields, and an extension-free title edit left imported guidance fresh. Native tag replacement canonicalizes values by trimming, lowercasing, deduplicating, and sorting before persistence.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Stopped the first full quick run after two failures. The 1 MiB framing case reported extension_mutation_guard_timed_out for pm-memory-forward-base before create and passed in isolation with and without V8 instrumentation. Follow-up pm-memory-forward-guard-timeout records that separate failure. The portable-forward file hit its 30-minute watchdog. Retrying the same coverage command with PM_TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT_MS=3600000 and the same assertions and thresholds.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round EI validation passed on the source and test changes through 7ccc351. Typecheck and lint passed. The focused recall, content, and direct-reference command passed 24 tests, and the native-host command passed 12. The coverage retry with PM_TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT_MS=3600000, PM_TEST_DEPTH=quick, and PM_TEST_TIME_SCALE=3 passed 924 tests with zero failures, cancellations, or skips and 100 percent statements, branches, functions, and lines across 40 source files. Changelog regeneration and check passed. The policy guard timeout remains tracked in pm-memory-forward-guard-timeout.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round ES addresses all four PR review findings. Preserve verification for equivalent field values, prepare each bulk update and persisted full-document fields in the native mutation, and compute conflict evidence from each requested prefix. Verify with real trackers and the package gates.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: The real tracker showed that replacing built-in command handlers emits ownership warnings before even unrelated JSON refusals. The revised integration uses parser and command-result extension services around native no-op and preview paths, and leaves the locked mutation guard active. Focused tests confirm bulk apply and rollback, persisted full-document normalization, no-op field updates, and shrinking recall projections.
